name: send_email
description: Send an email to the user

to_email.description: The recipient's email address to send the confirmation to

ticket_id.description: The unique ID of the 311 service ticket

category.description: The category of the issue reported (e.g., Pothole, Trash Missed)

description.description: A brief description of the issue

status.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., Open, In Progress, Closed)

message.description: Human-readable message about the result of sending the email
